content.text: In regions where platforms like PayPal and Stripe are unavailable or heavily restricted, digital creators face significant challenges in processing [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-get-payment-gateways-cameroon-digital-products-live|How to]]s. content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Payment gateway

No-KYC payment gateways allow digital sellers to accept payments without requiring customers to provide extensive personal information. This is crucial for creators in regions facing financial isolation. By using cryptocurrency as a payment method, sellers can secure transactions without relying on banks or traditional financial institutions. The significance of this infrastructure lies in its ability to empower creators to sell digital products—like ebooks and courses—while maintaining complete control over their revenue streams, ensuring they can operate efficiently in a restrictive environment.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The backbone of a no-KYC payment system involves several key components working in harmony. At the core, NOWPayments facilitates automatic crypto payment processing with minimal fees, typically around 0.5%. This is in stark contrast to platforms like Gumroad that charge up to 10%. Digital products can be hosted on platforms like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, while backend logic is managed through Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. This architecture allows for seamless product delivery, enabling creators to sell digital goods instantly while ensuring that they maintain ownership and control of their data.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is specifically designed for digital creators who find themselves locked out of mainstream payment solutions. It caters to individuals in countries such as Ghana, Kenya, and Venezuela, where conventional gateways are either unavailable or prohibitively expensive. Creators of ebooks, courses, templates, and other digital products can benefit from this architecture to reach a global audience with ease. By utilizing no-KYC payment solutions, they can avoid the high fees imposed by traditional platforms, allowing them to maximize their earnings and maintain their independence.
No-KYC payment gateways reduce your fees significantly, boosting your profits.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The effective deployment of a no-KYC payment gateway hinges on several interconnected components. It begins with a hosting platform such as GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for delivering digital products. Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script serves as the backend, managing order processing and automation. NOWPayments is integrated for efficient cryptocurrency payment processing. Each part plays a critical role in ensuring that transactions are secure, fast, and user-friendly. Additionally, infrastructure tools like Supabase can be used for order storage, ensuring that creators have complete access to their sales data.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To get started with a no-KYC payment gateway, first choose your hosting option, either GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, to set up your digital storefront. Next, implement backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to handle transactions. Integrate NOWPayments for crypto processing to facilitate payments with minimal fees. Load your products into the system, ensuring that everything is configured for seamless delivery. Finally, test the entire setup thoroughly before going live to ensure your digital store operates flawlessly. For a streamlined process, consider utilizing the Edge Commerce Stack ($197), which can be deployed within 48 hours.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

You can sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe by utilizing no-KYC payment solutions that handle cryptocurrency transactions. By hosting your digital products on platforms like Cloudflare Pages and integrating services like NOWPayments, you can create a fully operational store that does not depend on traditional payment gateways. This allows you to sell directly to customers while maintaining control over your revenue.
Retain complete control over your digital product sales and customer data.

Every digital product type — ebook, course, template, font, preset, beat, plugin, software license — works with the same sovereign commerce infrastructure. You build the product. NOWPayments handles the checkout. Your backend handles the delivery. You keep 99.5% of every sale. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH deploy the complete stack under your accounts in 48 hours. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you everything you need to build it yourself. Both paths lead to a store you own completely. See both at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.
Frequently Asked Questions
How can I sell digital downloads without platform fees?

To sell digital downloads without platform fees, utilize a no-KYC payment gateway that accepts cryptocurrencies. By hosting your products on platforms like Cloudflare and using NOWPayments, you can minimize costs and retain more profit.
What are the benefits of using a no-KYC payment gateway?

The benefits of using a no-KYC payment gateway include lower transaction fees, enhanced privacy for customers, and the ability to operate independently from traditional financial institutions. This is especially advantageous for creators in regions with limited access to conventional payment systems.
Is it possible to use cryptocurrencies in digital sales?

Yes, it is entirely possible to use cryptocurrencies in digital sales. By integrating a no-KYC payment gateway like NOWPayments, you can accept various cryptocurrencies for your digital products, ensuring secure and efficient transactions.
Can I sell templates and fonts without using Gumroad or Payhip?

Absolutely. You can sell templates and fonts by setting up your own online store using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages combined with NOWPayments for payment processing. This setup allows you to avoid fees associated with platforms like Gumroad or Payhip.
What types of digital products can I sell using this infrastructure?

You can sell a wide range of digital products, including ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, beats, plugins, and software. The flexibility of the infrastructure allows you to cater to various niches while maintaining control over your sales.
Empower yourself with a direct connection to your audience, free from traditional payment restrictions.
